gen-gf-bellota-gf-noticia-text: Uniform stylus lines and a sprawling s. Bellota keeps a constant stroke and moderate lowercase height, while Noticia Text stands taller, its curved letters taking a big visible entrance stroke.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-piazzolla: Commanding and distinctive, Bellota traces every diagonal and upright with a single stylus width. And Piazzolla, a serif with lowercase nearly matching its capitals, brings a gently opened e underneath.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-suwannaphum: Suwannaphum stands tall, its serif lowercase reaching high like woodblock type. Beneath Bellota's constant-width strokes, extended reading feels dignified and editorial, the open counters keeping each paragraph from clogging.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-epunda-slab: Open, unshaded letters with no calligraphic fuss. Epunda Slab's gaping c and tall rounded lowercase make paragraphs feel dignified, and Bellota Text leads into them without any shading to slow the eye.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-glegoo: Spare, wiry curves: Bellota Text traces each letter in a constant line at moderate lowercase height. Glegoo's taller, wide-mouthed letters and big counters keep long reading refined and editorial.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-noticia-text: Rod-like, unshaded strokes mark Bellota Text. Noticia Text, a text serif, has big entry strokes into each curve and lowercase filling most of the height, so it stands far taller beside it.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-pridi: Steady, pressure-free lines: Bellota Text holds a single pen angle all the way through, at a moderate lowercase height. Pridi's near-capital lowercase makes long reading feel classic and refined.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-slabo-13px: Slabo 13px reads bookish and dignified, with large open counters. Bellota Text, bent as if from one length of tubing, leads at moderate lowercase height, and the classic serif keeps long paragraphs clear.
gen-gf-bonbon-montserrat: Montserrat glides under the eye like wire, round letters with no stress tilt, all leading into generous white space. Bonbon's heavy, inviting handwriting adds warmth for brief bursts.
gen-gf-bonbon-work-sans: Contemporary and tidy, with c tips that never creep toward touching. Work Sans sits beside Bonbon's heavy, personal handwriting like wire next to ink, good for a brief burst of lines.
